title: Agent View: Multi-session management dashboard
description: New 'claude agents' command opens a dedicated screen showing all Claude Code sessions with visibility into running tasks, blocked items awaiting user input, and completed work. Also introduced /goal command for persistent tasks across turns, fast mode now defaults to Opus 4.7, and Rewind menu can summarize earlier context.

community_feedback.quote: Agent View centralizes multi-session management, though developers question if better visibility solves trust and workflow challenges
Show HN: Real-time dashboard for Claude Code agent teams - seeing what teams of agents are doing in real-time and filtering/searching their output

title: Plugins from .zip archives and URLs
description: Plugins can now load from .zip archives via --plugin-dir, and --plugin-url fetches plugin archives for the current session. Also added worktree.baseRef configuration, auto mode hard deny rules, and hooks now see active effort level.

title: Shared Canvases, /loop Skill, and Composer 2.5
description: Canvases created by agents can now be shared with team members via links. /loop skill enables agents to run prompts repeatedly on a schedule until outcomes are achieved. Cursor Automations moved to Agents Window with multi-repo and no-repo support. Composer 2.5 brings improved intelligence for sustained work on long-running tasks.

community_feedback.quote: Composer 2 was fantastic for my uses, and I hit Composer 2.5 with positive results
I pay $20 for Cursor, use Composer 2 almost exclusively

title: Jira Integration and Multi-repo Automations
description: Cursor is now available in Jira - assign work items to Cursor or mention @Cursor in comments to kick off cloud agents. Agents use work item details and repository settings to scope tasks. Automations now support multiple attached repos and can run without any repo attached with new templates for Slack, product analytics, FAQ, finance, and customer health monitoring.

community_feedback.quote: Mentions of Jira ticket auto-generation features

title: Model Control and Spend Management
description: May 4, 2026 update brought new model control system and upgraded spend management for enterprise admins.

title: Copilot Memory Controls and CLI Integration
description: GitHub added more controls for Copilot Memory deletion and scope. Repository admins can now disable Copilot Memory via repository-level off switch. New /memory commands in Copilot CLI: /memory list, /memory delete, and /memory off for viewing, deleting, and opting out of memory storage.

community_feedback.quote: I found out that the memory options in Copilot is on, eventhough there are no settings (at least in the EU) to control it
GitHub community discussions highlight critical issues with repo-specific memories and advocacy for better error states and manual controls

title: Fixes for Devin Local and Bug Fixes
description: Version 2.3.1012 - Repaired hooks for Devin Local to allow blocking user prompts, improved plan mode in Devin Local to work in the OS sandbox, and increased remote server startup timeout from 2.5s to 6s.

title: Bug Fixes and Improvements
description: Version 2.3.1008 - Fixed availability issues with swe-check model for some users, improved terminal processing performance, and restored conversation sharing.

title: Claude Opus 4.7 (fast mode)
description: Claude Opus 4.7 (fast mode) is now available in Windsurf, with the full intelligence of Opus 4.7 but ~2.5x higher output speeds.

title: Devin Review & Quick Review
description: Version 2.2.1017 - All Windsurf IDE users now have access to Devin Review and Quick Review with existing subscription. Added Agent Command Center improvements including list display option for agent inbox, improved sessions sidebar sorting and filtering, and performance improvements for loading and switching sessions.

title: Settings Improvements and Agent Command Center
description: Version 2.2.1001 - Settings now open in a dedicated tab with searchable sidebar, consolidated settings gear into global activity dropdown. Added space @-mentions, automatic context sharing across sessions, model picker search improvements, and various UI/UX improvements for Agent Command Center.

title: Platform Default Settings, Slack Channel Override, MCP OAuth Resource Parameter
description: Org admins can set default platform (Linux/Windows) for sessions. Slack channel override via !channel command. MCP OAuth flows now forward RFC 8707 resource parameter for authentication. GitLab interactive PR review support. PR Review Status API endpoint added.

title: Collapsible Session Folders, Archive All Sessions, Default Member Roles
description: Sessions can be organized into collapsible folders. 'Archive all' option in sidebar menu. Enterprise admins can configure default roles for new organization members. GHES app registration restriction. Copyable Organization ID.

title: Snapshot Build Delete, MCP Multiline Environment Variables, Settings Redesign
description: Delete snapshot builds from build history. Multiline environment variable values for MCP servers. Settings redesigned with hub-style layout and improved search. Archive active session warning. Share session on mobile. Devin Review mobile improvements.

title: Devin Review API, Mermaid Diagram Rendering, Per-PR Auto-Review Toggle
description: Devin Review can be triggered programmatically via REST API. Mermaid code blocks render as interactive SVG diagrams. Per-PR auto-review toggle. Sidebar session notifications with persistent status labels and read/unread indicators.

title: Stacked Review Permissions, Skill Slash Commands, Auto-Fix Includes CI Checks
description: Enterprise admins can assign tiered PR Review access levels. Skills can be invoked by typing /name. Auto-fix button now includes failing CI check names. Session origin field in v3 API. Higher-quality Wiki v2 with stronger reasoning.

title: Revamped Blueprint Authoring, Enterprise Commit Email Lock, PR Auto-Close Removed
description: Blueprint editor redesigned with shared layout and per-section play buttons. Enterprise admins can require commits use user's primary email. PRs no longer auto-close when session ends. Hybrid comment mode in Devin Review.

title: Search Across Conversation History
description: Codex CLI 0.134.0 - Added search across conversation history with /search command. Profile selector improvements for easier model switching. Enhanced MCP setup with better error messages and validation.

title: Appshots, Goal Mode, Remote Computer Use
description: May 21, 2026 update introduced Appshots for saving application states, Goal Mode for persistent multi-step tasks, and Remote Computer Use capabilities for controlling remote machines.

title: Mobile App Connections
description: May 14, 2026 update added ability to connect and use Codex CLI from mobile devices with improved cross-platform synchronization.

title: Surgical Code Edits and Session Portability
description: Gemini CLI v0.43.0 (May 22, 2026) - Surgical Code Edits feature for precise code modifications. Session Portability allows export/import of sessions. Adaptive Token Estimation for better token usage prediction. Improved UI Rendering and Enhanced Agent Architecture.
